notes.name: Hacury Monster
notes.legend: Journeying folk say a relic monster of 7 ft long inhabits Hacury Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

notes.name: Gasingsbu Monster
notes.legend: Old sailors tell stories of a gigantic sea monster inhabiting these dangerous waters. Rumors say it can be 21 ft long.

notes.name: Midfordbu Hag
notes.legend: Locals speak of a horrifying Hag who inhabits Midfordbu hills and prefers eating children.

notes.name: Portsterke Undead
notes.legend: Rumors speak of a prime Undead who inhabits Portsterke hills and prefers eating children.

notes.name: Travelling Extraordinary Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this extraordinary circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Travelling World-famous Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this world-famous circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Lympstondon Tournament
notes.legend: Warriors from around the land gather for a tournament of the greats in Lympstondon, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

notes.name: Mamerstoney Fair
notes.legend: A fair is being held in Mamerstoney, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

notes.name: Minor Jetty
notes.legend: A small location along the Barton River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

notes.name: Snakes migration
notes.legend: A huge group of snakes are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

notes.name: Diaphanous mirage
notes.legend: This diaphanous mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

notes.name: Salboleham Sinkhole
notes.legend: The Salboleham Sinkhole. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

notes.name: Bridle Necropolis
notes.legend: An eerie necropolis where nature intertwines with death. Overgrown tombstones are entwined by thorny vines, and mournful spirits wander among the fading petals of once-vibrant flowers.
